traditionalDress.men: Dhoti or traditional trousers with a kurta; the pheta is a regional ceremonial turban style.
traditionalDress.women: Nauvari saree and other Marathi saree drapes are associated with traditional and festive dress.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.description: A major public and household festival in Maharashtra, celebrated with Ganesha images, prayer, music, community gatherings and immersion rituals.

festivals.name: Gudi Padwa
festivals.description: The Marathi New Year, marked by the raising of a gudi standard, festive foods and household observances.

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.description: A harvest-season festival associated in Maharashtra with tilgul sweets and social greetings.

artsCrafts: Bidri craft traditions in the Marathwada cultural region
folklore: Maharashtra's folk storytelling and performance culture includes powada ballads, devotional abhang traditions and Tamasha, which blend music, poetry, dialogue and performance.
